Report what is wrong with a GeoParquet file

Source: R/parquet-validate.R
geo_validate_parquet.Rd

One row per finding (design section 6.11), the checks gpq validate makes and those GeoParquet 2.0 adds. Errors break the specification: a missing or malformed geo key (geo_key_missing, geo_key_invalid, version_invalid, primary_column_invalid, columns_invalid, primary_column_not_in_columns), a column entry that breaks the schema (encoding_invalid, geometry_types_invalid, crs_invalid, orientation_invalid, edges_invalid, bbox_invalid, epoch_invalid), a geometry column that is missing, nested, repeated or not BYTE_ARRAY (column_missing, column_grouped, column_repeated, column_not_byte_array), a 2.0 column without the native type (native_type_missing) or not in the geo key (column_undeclared), and the geo key and native type disagreeing (crs_mismatch, edges_mismatch, crs_key_missing). The data scan adds WKB that does not parse (wkb_invalid), types the metadata does not list (geometry_type_undeclared), rings against a declared orientation (orientation_wrong), geometries outside the geo key's bbox (bbox_exceeded), and row groups whose native statistics miss their data (statistics_exceeded, statistics_types).

Usage

geo_validate_parquet(path, metadata_only = FALSE)

Arguments

path

A Parquet file path.

metadata_only

TRUE to skip the data scan, as gpq validate --metadata-only does.

Value

A data frame of column (NA for the file), row_group and row (NA when the finding is not about one), issue, severity ("error" or "warning") and message; no rows when nothing is wrong.

Details

Warnings are geometries that are not valid simple features, as geo_validate() reports them (winding only where orientation is declared), and the advice of the GeoParquet distribution guide that the file shows: compression other than zstd (not_zstd), row groups over 200,000 rows (row_group_large), and row groups whose boxes overlap so much that the data cannot be spatially ordered (not_spatially_ordered). The crs is checked to be a JSON object or null, not validated against the PROJJSON schema. Needs the qio package.

See also

geo_validate(), geo_parquet_info()

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet")
geo_write_parquet(geo_points(1:3, 1:3, crs = "OGC:CRS84"), path)
geo_validate_parquet(path)
#> [1] column    row_group row       issue     severity  message  
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
